system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template defining a custom-mode VPC with two subnets (public, private), a Cloud NAT gateway for the private subnet, and firewall rules allowing internal traffic.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template defining a custom-mode VPC with two subnets (public, private), a Cloud NAT gateway for the private subnet, and firewall rules allowing internal traffic.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: prod-vpc
  type: compute.v1.network
  properties:
    autoCreateSubnetworks: false
    routingConfig:
      routingMode: REGIONAL

- name: public-subnet
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    region: us-central1
    ipCidrRange: 10.0.1.0/24
    privateIpGoogleAccess: true
    enableFlowLogs: true
    logConfig:
      enable: true
      aggregationInterval: INTERVAL_5_SEC
      flowSampling: 0.5
      metadata: INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA

- name: private-subnet
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    region: us-central1
    ipCidrRange: 10.0.2.0/24
    privateIpGoogleAccess: true
    enableFlowLogs: true
    logConfig:
      enable: true
      aggregationInterval: INTERVAL_5_SEC
      flowSampling: 0.5
      metadata: INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA

- name: nat-router
  type: compute.v1.router
  properties:
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    region: us-central1
    bgp:
      asn: 64514

- name: nat-gateway
  action: gcp-types/compute-v1:compute.routers.patch
  properties:
    router: $(ref.nat-router.name)
    region: us-central1
    nats:
    - name: prod-nat-gateway
      natIpAllocateOption: AUTO_ONLY
      sourceSubnetworkIpRangesToNat: LIST_OF_SUBNETWORKS
      subnetworks:
      - name: $(ref.private-subnet.selfLink)
        sourceIpRangesToNat:
        - ALL_IP_RANGES
      logConfig:
        enable: true
        filter: ERRORS_ONLY
      minPortsPerVm: 64
      udpIdleTimeoutSec: 30
      tcpEstablishedIdleTimeoutSec: 1200
      tcpTransitoryIdleTimeoutSec: 30
      icmpIdleTimeoutSec: 30

- name: fw-allow-internal
  type: compute.v1.firewall
  properties:
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    direction: INGRESS
    priority: 1000
    sourceRanges:
    - 10.0.0.0/16
    allowed:
    - IPProtocol: tcp
      ports:
      - "0-65535"
    - IPProtocol: udp
      ports:
      - "0-65535"
    - IPProtocol: icmp
    logConfig:
      enable: true

- name: fw-allow-iap-ssh
  type: compute.v1.firewall
  properties:
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    direction: INGRESS
    priority: 1000
    sourceRanges:
    - 35.235.240.0/20
    targetTags:
    - ssh-allowed
    allowed:
    - IPProtocol: tcp
      ports:
      - "22"
    logConfig:
      enable: true

- name: fw-deny-all-ingress
  type: compute.v1.firewall
  properties:
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    direction: INGRESS
    priority: 65534
    sourceRanges:
    - 0.0.0.0/0
    denied:
    - IPProtocol: all
    logConfig:
      enable: true

outputs:
- name: networkSelfLink
  value: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
- name: publicSubnet
  value: $(ref.public-subnet.selfLink)
- name: privateSubnet
  value: $(ref.private-subnet.selfLink)
